LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_Vacsuit_Prestige.label: Whitespring command vacsuit
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_Vacsuit_Prestige.description: A decorated vacuum suit issued to senior Whitespring aerospace personnel. It protects its wearer in vacuum at the cost of mobility, while woven cryptex filaments enhance psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_VacsuitHelmet_Prestige.label: Whitespring command vacsuit helmet
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_VacsuitHelmet_Prestige.descr: A decorated sealed helmet issued to senior Whitespring aerospace personnel. Its recycling system sustains breathable air for hours before repressurization is required, while embedded cryptex filaments enhance psychic sensitivity.
